content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Freddy and I must be siblings. We both have the exact same two moles on our left arm and you only get that with siblings. My parents say this could also be pure coincidence. But that much of a coincidence is simply impossible.
What is the relation between "We both have the exact same two moles on our left arm" and "My parents say this could also be pure coincidence." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
